mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals monetary tightening, which raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.0% triggers investor concerns about inflation, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 2.0% in high inflation periods (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) and falling unemployment rates (UNRATE < 6.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy and a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite the combination of low FEDFUNDS and falling UNRATE in expansionary regimes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, high demand growth (GDPC1) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) signal overvaluation in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during late-cycle expansion despite high GDPC1 and low FEDFUNDS (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a strengthening labor market, attracting investment to equities and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 5.0% in improving labor markets (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) and rising job growth (PAYEMS > 137,318) signals a robust labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative despite the combination of falling UNRATE and rising PAYEMS in strong labor markets (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A peak in supply growth (INDPRO crossing above 110.4) signals overproduction in the economy, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite INDPRO peaking above 110.4 in supply cycles (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a recessionary regime (high FEDFUNDS and elevated UNRATE), S&P 500 forward returns are expected to be negative due to economic contraction risks over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive during recessionary conditions despite high FEDFUNDS and UNRATE (t-test p < 0.05).
